topology_reasoning.visual_classification: A laterally symmetric, multi-rail adiabatic coupler / comb-like transition. The material image contains two mirrored tapered, nested U-like bodies (one above and one below the centerline), separated by a five-rail straight transfer region.
observed_structure: The overall material bbox is 120 um by 4 um.
The upper and lower halves are approximately mirrored about y=2 um.
Each half has an outer and an inner tapered rail/body: narrow separated side material at the outside edge evolves into a broad central body toward the transfer region.
Five narrow, nearly full-length, parallel straight material rails occupy the central gap.
The leading visual fidelity determinants are the taper length, the two nested rail widths/offsets, the central-rail pitch, and the short gaps between those elements.
topology_reasoning.working_implementation: Use only GDSFactory primitive assemblies: mirrored gf.Path extrusions for the tapered nested rails/bodies and gf.components.straight for the five transfer rails. A small real length difference between two central rails exposes a transfer-length knob for the parametric-response proof without altering the inferred topology.

iterations.change_made: Initial primitives-only reconstruction: linear nested tapered frames, five inner ladder rungs, and five central transfer rails.

Replaced linear upper/lower frame flares with piecewise primitive taper profiles fitted to the observed curved edges; separated the final ladder rung from the outer body and aligned the central rails.
